name: Louisiana
agency: Louisiana Office of Motor Vehicles (OMV), Department of Public Safety
permitAge: 15 (learner's permit), after a 38-hour driver education course (30 hours classroom, 8 hours behind the wheel), vision test and knowledge test (handbook p. 7)

teen.supervisedHours: 50 hours, including 15 at night, attested by a parent (handbook p. 7; R.S. 32:407)
teen.nightLimit: Intermediate license: no driving 11 p.m. to 5 a.m. unless with a licensed parent or guardian, a licensed adult 21+, or a licensed sibling 18+ (handbook p. 7; R.S. 32:407)
teen.passengerLimit: Intermediate license: from 6 p.m. to 5 a.m., no more than one passenger under 21 who is not immediate family, unless a licensed parent, guardian or adult 21+ is along (handbook p. 7; R.S. 32:407)
teen.phone: All drivers: R.S. 32:59 (Act 288 of 2025, eff. Aug. 1, 2025) bans hand-held use; hands-free calls and hands-free GPS allowed. Fine $250 in a school or highway construction zone (primary offense), $100 elsewhere (secondary offense), doubled after a crash; warnings only before Jan. 1, 2026. The former learner/intermediate and under-18 phone bans (R.S. 32:300.5-300.8) were repealed by the same act. R.S. 32:289.1 still bars any phone use during the first year of a first driver's license (secondary offense).

notes: Handbook: Class D & E Driver's Guide, DPSMV2052 (R08/25), 143-page PDF hosted on the DPS PowerDMS site and linked from https://expresslane.la.gov/omv/resources/driver-manuals/. Printed page = PDF page minus 5. No official Spanish guide found on the OMV site.
Knowledge test: 40 questions, 80% to pass (OMV permits page); handbook p. 8 gives 80% but no question count.

Test language: the OMV new-licenses page says applicants who do not understand written English may bring a translator to any non-CDL knowledge test. No list of test languages found. Knowledge and skills tests for teens are given by the driver education provider.
Learner supervisor: licensed parent, guardian, adult 21+, or licensed sibling 18+ (R.S. 32:407; handbook p. 7 lists adult 21+ or sibling 18+).

Intermediate license at 16 requires 180 days on the permit with no at-fault crashes and no convictions for moving, seat belt, curfew, or drug/alcohol violations (R.S. 32:407(A)(3)(c)), and a road skills test. Full Class E at 17.
Handbook p. 111 still describes the old ban on calls/texts by drivers 17 and younger; that law (R.S. 32:300.7) was repealed by Act 288 of 2025. Questions follow current law.

Move over (R.S. 32:125 as shown on legis.la.gov, last amended 2021): change to a non-adjacent lane if possible, otherwise slow; on a two-lane road keep a safe speed. A 2026 expansion to disabled vehicles with hazard lights is reported (WAFB, Aug. 2026) but not yet visible on the legislature site, so la-018 stays medium.
School bus on divided highways (R.S. 32:80): not checked; no question written.
